title: A Comet From Another Star Passed Us at 130,000 mph

scenes.text: A comet from another star raced past at 130,000 mph.
Astronomers named it three I ATLAS, and found it in July 2025.
It's only the third object ever seen entering our solar system from deep space.
At about 130,000 miles an hour, it's the fastest comet ever observed.
That speed suggests it has drifted between the stars for billions of years.
It came no closer to Earth than 167 million miles, and now it's leaving for good.

description:
A comet from another star system, 3I/ATLAS, was found in July 2025. It is only the third interstellar object ever detected, and the fastest comet ever observed at about 130,000 miles an hour.
Where do you think it came from?
